# Locations & Battles

## Avenue {#avenue}

The Avenue is a four- or five-hundred-yard stretch of road near [Newbridge](../codex/places.md#newbridge) that is completely arched over by large apple trees planted by an old farmer.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P40](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P41](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0041), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P42](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P43](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0043), +14 more_

## Avonlea {#avonlea}

Avonlea is the hometown of a group of young scholars who left to attend the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P1](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P2](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P3](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P4](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0004), +42 more_

**Associated with:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md), [Major Spencer](../character/major-spencer.md), [Prillie Rogerson](../character/prillie-rogerson.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Robert Bell](../character/robert-bell.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md)

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends her summer vacation in Avonlea, feeling a quiet loneliness over her strained friendship with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). She enjoys visits with [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), and Miss Lavendar, though [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) realizes he is growing too old for his childhood imaginary friends, and Miss Lavendar cautions [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) were meant for each other.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIII Paul Cannot Find the Rock People

_Sources: [v3 ch.People P0](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0000), [v3 ch.People P1](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0001), [v3 ch.People P15](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0015), [v3 ch.People P31](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0031)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), who has just given birth to her baby boy, little [Fred](../character/fred-wright.md). Joined by Mrs. Allan, they talk about motherhood and childhood memories, which leaves [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feeling lonely and disconnected as she walks home alone.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXIX Deals with Weddings

_Sources: [v3 ch.Weddings P41](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0041), [v3 ch.Weddings P43](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0043), [v3 ch.Weddings P45](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0045), [v3 ch.Weddings P51](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0051)_

Beechwood is the residence of Diana's [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) located in town.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P5](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P6](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. **Associated with:** [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md)

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) invites [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on a trip to town with her [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) to attend the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). The girls stay at Aunt Josephine's mansion, enjoying the sights, horse races, and a night concert before happily returning home.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life

## Birch Path {#birch-path}

Named by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), the Birch Path is a picturesque, narrow, and spicy-aired pathway fringed with young birches and wildflowers that winds through Mr. Bell's woods on the route to the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P70](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0070), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P0](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Bolingbroke {#bolingbroke}

Bolingbroke is a place in [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) that is the birthplace of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and the home of [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 ch.Lady P29](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0029), [v3 ch.Lady P30](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0030), [v3 ch.Lady P31](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0031), +15 more_

**Associated with:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md)

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a pleasant fortnight in Bolingbroke with [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), where she visits her birthplace and explores her parents' old home. The current occupant gives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a bundle of old love letters written by her parents. After visiting their graves, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reads the letters at [Mount Holly](../codex/places.md#mount-holly) and feels truly connected to her parents for the first time.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXI Roses of Yesterday

_Sources: [v3 ch.Yesterday P4](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0004), [v3 ch.Yesterday P12](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0012), [v3 ch.Yesterday P15](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0015), [v3 ch.Yesterday P20](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0020)_

## Boston {#boston}

Boston is a noisy, crowded city where [Jordan](../character/jordan.md) Gray worked for a winter and Hester Murray worked in a store prior to their marriage, and where [Jordan](../character/jordan.md) returned following her death.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P47](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0047), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P48](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0048), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P49](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0049), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P50](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0050), +8 more_

## Bright River {#bright-river}

Bright River is a location reachable by an eight-mile drive from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) Cuthbert's home, featuring a train station house with a long platform and ladies' waiting room, as well as a small local hotel.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P12](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P14](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P15](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0015), +26 more_

> [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) travels to the Bright River station to pick up an expected orphan boy, only to discover a chatterbox orphan girl waiting for him instead. Unable to explain the mistake, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) decides to take her along in his buggy, finding himself surprisingly charmed by her imaginative talking.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P4](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER II. ## Carmody {#carmody}

Carmody is a nearby community with a school taught by [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), as well as shopping facilities accessed via a road connecting it with [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) and [Newbridge](../codex/places.md#newbridge).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P53](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0053), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P54](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0054), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P55](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0055), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P56](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0056), +18 more_

Charlottetown is a location on Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island) featuring red roads that run past it and can be seen from the train.

## Columbia {#columbia}

St. Columbia is a place home to an institution where divinity students, including [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/jonas.md), study and graduate.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P5](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0005), [v3 ch.Jonas P6](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0006), [v3 ch.Jonas P7](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0007), [v3 ch.Jonas P8](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0008), +23 more_

## Convocation {#convocation}

Convocation is a college graduation event where students who have finished their examinations receive their caps, diplomas, and B.A. degrees from the president of [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Friend P19](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0019), [v3 ch.Friend P20](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0020), [v3 ch.Friend P21](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0021), [v3 ch.Friend P22](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0022), +20 more_

## Crystal Lake {#crystal-lake}

Crystal Lake is a boggy pool named after a suggestion by [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) was drawn from a hat by [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md).

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P23](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0023), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P24](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0024), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P25](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0025), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P26](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0026), +7 more_

## Dryad’s Bubble {#dryad-s-bubble}

the Dryad’s Bubble is a spring located near a log bridge and surrounded by ferns and birch trees, named by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P36](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0036), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P37](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0037), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P38](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P39](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0039), +15 more_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share a dramatic, tearful farewell near the Dryad's Bubble after Diana's mother forbids them from playing together. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) informs [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) of their permanent separation and decides to return to school, where her classmates welcome her back. Despite the forced estrangement from [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) channels her energy into her studies, engaging in a intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P14](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. > [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) bedtime-talks with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about trying to be good, after which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) near the Dryad's Bubble to discuss their village improvement society's progress and upcoming plans. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and chats with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her busy schedule for the next day.
>
> — v2 · XIX Just a Happy Day

## East Grafton {#east-grafton}

East Grafton is a settlement home to a gravely ill distant relative of [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) named Mary, whose residents did not get along particularly well with her.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P12](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0012), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P13](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0013), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P14](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0014), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), +14 more_

## Echo Lodge {#echo-lodge}

Echo Lodge is a stone house inhabited by Miss Lavendar, which is scheduled to be boarded up and left empty during the winters while being used as a summer home following her marriage.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P73](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0073), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P74](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0074), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P75](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0075), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P76](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0076), +15 more_

> At school, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) gets into a dispute over a picture drawn on a slate, while [Dora](../character/dora.md) becomes frightened of staying in the dark after [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) shares stories of her family's ghosts. Later in October, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) get lost in the woods on their way to a tea party and stumble upon Echo Lodge. There they meet the eccentric Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her maid [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), who invite them to stay for tea.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)_

> Miss Lavendar entertains [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and Charlotta the Fourth with tea and demonstrates the magical echoes around Echo Lodge. After explaining the history of her succession of 'Charlottas,' Miss Lavendar is shaken when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) casually mentions [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), the son of her former lover, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). The girls bid a warm farewell to a visibly saddened Miss Lavendar and reflect on her and their own names as they leave.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P64](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0064), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P81](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0081), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P87](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0087)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks through the woods to Echo Lodge to spend an evening with Miss Lavendar while Charlotta the Fourth is away. Over tea and candy, Miss Lavendar confides in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her past romance and broken engagement with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). A month later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) brings Stephen's son, [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), to meet Miss Lavendar, and the two quickly bond.
>
> — v2 · XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P4](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0004), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P15](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0015), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P26](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0026)_

> While picking berries, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) confides her worries about Miss Lavendar's melancholic mood to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to plan an extended visit during her vacation to cheer her up. After returning to Echo Lodge for tea, Miss Lavendar and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) share a tender conversation about their shared imagination and dream-people before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) depart.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P49](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0049), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P51](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0051), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P62](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0062)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Echo Lodge and helps Miss Lavendar make a new dress before visiting [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). There, she meets Paul's father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), who asks her to carry a message to Miss Lavendar about visiting her. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivers the note and helps an excited Miss Lavendar prepare for Stephen's arrival.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P17](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0017), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057)_

Eden is a biblical location mentioned in reference to a perfection or innocence prior to trouble.

## Edward Island {#edward-island}

## West Grafton {#west-grafton}

West Grafton is a location accessible via a road that can be reached by walking straight back through the woods from the [Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) farm.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P8](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0008), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P9](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0009), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P10](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0010), +20 more_

## White Sands Hotel {#white-sands-hotel}

Located along the shore road, the White Sands Hotel is run by Mr. Kirke and serves as a summer resort popular with [American](../codex/factions.md#american) visitors.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P22](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P23](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P24](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0024), +18 more_

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dress for a benefit concert at the White Sands Hotel, with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) offering pragmatic advice before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaves with [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md). At the hotel, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) suffers from severe stage fright upon facing the sophisticated crowd and accomplished performers. However, after spotting [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the audience, she finds her determination, delivers a successful recitation, gets encored, and is warmly praised by the guests.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

## Willowmere {#willowmere}

Willowmere is a location passed by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) on their romantic walk to the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school after traversing Mr. Barry's back field.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P70](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0070), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P0](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XV.
